landing.title: Pygmalion
landing.what_is_text_1: A space where presence is recorded through impulses, not through accumulation.
landing.what_is_text_2: There are no ratings, performance metrics, or social competition here.
landing.what_is_text_3: There is only the form of participation — the visible geometry of trust.
landing.how_to_read_text_1: Every day you emit into the NOD platform "P./K." at any time from 20:00 to 19:55 from 3 to 13 R.U. (first stage). You choose where to direct your attention.
landing.how_to_read_text_2: At 00:00, all impulses (if not all used) burn. This is not a loss — it is the NOD platform's exhale.
landing.how_to_read_text_3: Only the trace remains: R.M. and the geometry of connections you created.
landing.quote_text: It is so weird that no one cares about their legacy because they don't see a future. So what I'm trying to say is I'm desperate to get you a future so that you care.
landing.entry_text: Entry is a choice. The system does not require registration, but it requires presence.
landing.footer:

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.intro: You stand at the threshold of a space where presence is recorded, not accumulated.
threshold.principle_1: Every day you emit into the NOD platform "P./K." at any time from 20:00 to 19:55 from 3 to 13 R.U. (first stage). You choose where to direct your attention.
threshold.principle_2: At midnight UTC, all impulses burn. This is not a loss — it is the system's exhale.
threshold.principle_3: Only the trace remains — the geometry of connections you created.
threshold.principle_4: The system breathes on its own. The field lives in time without an observer.
threshold.question: Are you ready to enter this space and leave your trace?
threshold.error_format: OK format: ::name:: (letters, numbers, dots, dashes, underscores only)
